language=plpgsql; volatility=VOLATILE; definition=CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analyze_legacy_cash_balances()<br> RETURNS TABLE("TenantId" uuid, "TenantName" character varying, "SharedCashBalance" numeric, "CashboxCount" bigint, "DedicatedTreasuryCount" bigint, "MigrationCategory" text, "CashboxIds" uuid[], "CashboxNames" text[], "HasInvalidTenantId" boolean)<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    RETURN QUERY<br>    WITH generic_cash AS (<br>        -- Find all treasury accounts linked to the shared cash account (1010)<br>        -- with no ReferenceCode (indicating legacy/generic, not dedicated)<br>        SELECT<br>            t."TenantId",<br>            t."Id" AS "TreasuryAccountId",<br>            t."Name" AS "TreasuryAccountName",<br>            a."Id" AS "LedgerAccountId",<br>            a."AccountCode",<br>            a."CurrentBalance"<br>        FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>        INNER JOIN "LedgerAccounts" a<br>            ON a."Id" = t."AccountId"<br>        WHERE NOT t."IsDeleted"<br>          AND NOT a."IsDeleted"<br>          AND t."Type" = 1  -- Cashbox type<br>          AND COALESCE(t."ReferenceCode", '') = ''  -- No reference code = legacy<br>          AND a."AccountCode" = '1010'  -- Shared cash account<br>          AND ABS(a."CurrentBalance") &gt; 0.0001  -- Has non-zero balance<br>    ),<br>    tenant_balances AS (<br>        -- Aggregate balances per tenant<br>        SELECT<br>            gc."TenantId",<br>            SUM(gc."CurrentBalance") AS "TotalBalance"<br>        FROM generic_cash gc<br>        GROUP BY gc."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    cashbox_info AS (<br>        -- Count cashboxes per tenant<br>        SELECT<br>            c."TenantId",<br>            COUNT(*) AS "CashboxCount",<br>            ARRAY_AGG(c."Id" ORDER BY c."Name") AS "CashboxIds",<br>            ARRAY_AGG(c."Name" ORDER BY c."Name") AS "CashboxNames"<br>        FROM "Cashboxes" c<br>        WHERE NOT c."IsDeleted"<br>        GROUP BY c."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    dedicated_treasury AS (<br>        -- Count dedicated treasury accounts (with ReferenceCode)<br>        SELECT<br>            t."TenantId",<br>            COUNT(*) AS "DedicatedCount"<br>        FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>        WHERE NOT t."IsDeleted"<br>          AND t."Type" = 1<br>          AND COALESCE(t."ReferenceCode", '') &lt;&gt; ''<br>        GROUP BY t."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    tenant_names AS (<br>        -- Get tenant names (assuming StoreTenants table or similar)<br>        SELECT <br>            st."Id" AS "TenantId",<br>            COALESCE(st."Name", st."StoreName", 'Unknown') AS "Name"<br>        FROM "StoreTenants" st<br>        WHERE NOT st."IsDeleted"<br>    )<br>    SELECT<br>        tb."TenantId",<br>        tn."Name" AS "TenantName",<br>        tb."TotalBalance" AS "SharedCashBalance",<br>        COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0)::bigint AS "CashboxCount",<br>        COALESCE(dt."DedicatedCount", 0)::bigint AS "DedicatedTreasuryCount",<br>        CASE<br>            -- Case D: Invalid tenant ID (all zeros or null-like)<br>            WHEN tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid <br>                 OR tb."TenantId" IS NULL<br>            THEN 'D_INVALID_TENANT'<br>            <br>            -- Case C: No cashboxes - requires remediation<br>            WHEN COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0) = 0<br>            THEN 'C_NO_CASHBOX'<br>            <br>            -- Case A: Exactly 1 cashbox - auto-migrate<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" = 1<br>            THEN 'A_AUTO_MIGRATE'<br>            <br>            -- Case B: Multiple cashboxes - requires manual allocation<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" &gt; 1<br>            THEN 'B_MULTIPLE_CASHBOXES'<br>            <br>            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'<br>        END AS "MigrationCategory",<br>        ci."CashboxIds",<br>        ci."CashboxNames",<br>        (tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AS "HasInvalidTenantId"<br>    FROM tenant_balances tb<br>    LEFT JOIN cashbox_info ci ON ci."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    LEFT JOIN dedicated_treasury dt ON dt."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    LEFT JOIN tenant_names tn ON tn."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    ORDER BY <br>        CASE<br>            WHEN tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid THEN 0<br>            WHEN COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0) = 0 THEN 1<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" = 1 THEN 2<br>            ELSE 3<br>        END,<br>        ABS(tb."TotalBalance") DESC;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | `LEGACY DRIFT` | `public.analyze_legacy_cash_balances()` exists in the legacy database but is absent from the certified runtime-model baseline. Definition: return=TABLE("TenantId" uuid, "TenantName" character varying, "SharedCashBalance" numeric, "CashboxCount" bigint, "DedicatedTreasuryCount" bigint, "MigrationCategory" text, "CashboxIds" uuid[], "CashboxNames" text[], "HasInvalidTenantId" boolean); language=plpgsql; volatility=VOLATILE; definition=CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analyze_legacy_cash_balances()<br> RETURNS TABLE("TenantId" uuid, "TenantName" character varying, "SharedCashBalance" numeric, "CashboxCount" bigint, "DedicatedTreasuryCount" bigint, "MigrationCategory" text, "CashboxIds" uuid[], "CashboxNames" text[], "HasInvalidTenantId" boolean)<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    RETURN QUERY<br>    WITH generic_cash AS (<br>        -- Find all treasury accounts linked to the shared cash account (1010)<br>        -- with no ReferenceCode (indicating legacy/generic, not dedicated)<br>        SELECT<br>            t."TenantId",<br>            t."Id" AS "TreasuryAccountId",<br>            t."Name" AS "TreasuryAccountName",<br>            a."Id" AS "LedgerAccountId",<br>            a."AccountCode",<br>            a."CurrentBalance"<br>        FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>        INNER JOIN "LedgerAccounts" a<br>            ON a."Id" = t."AccountId"<br>        WHERE NOT t."IsDeleted"<br>          AND NOT a."IsDeleted"<br>          AND t."Type" = 1  -- Cashbox type<br>          AND COALESCE(t."ReferenceCode", '') = ''  -- No reference code = legacy<br>          AND a."AccountCode" = '1010'  -- Shared cash account<br>          AND ABS(a."CurrentBalance") &gt; 0.0001  -- Has non-zero balance<br>    ),<br>    tenant_balances AS (<br>        -- Aggregate balances per tenant<br>        SELECT<br>            gc."TenantId",<br>            SUM(gc."CurrentBalance") AS "TotalBalance"<br>        FROM generic_cash gc<br>        GROUP BY gc."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    cashbox_info AS (<br>        -- Count cashboxes per tenant<br>        SELECT<br>            c."TenantId",<br>            COUNT(*) AS "CashboxCount",<br>            ARRAY_AGG(c."Id" ORDER BY c."Name") AS "CashboxIds",<br>            ARRAY_AGG(c."Name" ORDER BY c."Name") AS "CashboxNames"<br>        FROM "Cashboxes" c<br>        WHERE NOT c."IsDeleted"<br>        GROUP BY c."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    dedicated_treasury AS (<br>        -- Count dedicated treasury accounts (with ReferenceCode)<br>        SELECT<br>            t."TenantId",<br>            COUNT(*) AS "DedicatedCount"<br>        FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>        WHERE NOT t."IsDeleted"<br>          AND t."Type" = 1<br>          AND COALESCE(t."ReferenceCode", '') &lt;&gt; ''<br>        GROUP BY t."TenantId"<br>    ),<br>    tenant_names AS (<br>        -- Get tenant names (assuming StoreTenants table or similar)<br>        SELECT <br>            st."Id" AS "TenantId",<br>            COALESCE(st."Name", st."StoreName", 'Unknown') AS "Name"<br>        FROM "StoreTenants" st<br>        WHERE NOT st."IsDeleted"<br>    )<br>    SELECT<br>        tb."TenantId",<br>        tn."Name" AS "TenantName",<br>        tb."TotalBalance" AS "SharedCashBalance",<br>        COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0)::bigint AS "CashboxCount",<br>        COALESCE(dt."DedicatedCount", 0)::bigint AS "DedicatedTreasuryCount",<br>        CASE<br>            -- Case D: Invalid tenant ID (all zeros or null-like)<br>            WHEN tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid <br>                 OR tb."TenantId" IS NULL<br>            THEN 'D_INVALID_TENANT'<br>            <br>            -- Case C: No cashboxes - requires remediation<br>            WHEN COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0) = 0<br>            THEN 'C_NO_CASHBOX'<br>            <br>            -- Case A: Exactly 1 cashbox - auto-migrate<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" = 1<br>            THEN 'A_AUTO_MIGRATE'<br>            <br>            -- Case B: Multiple cashboxes - requires manual allocation<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" &gt; 1<br>            THEN 'B_MULTIPLE_CASHBOXES'<br>            <br>            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'<br>        END AS "MigrationCategory",<br>        ci."CashboxIds",<br>        ci."CashboxNames",<br>        (tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AS "HasInvalidTenantId"<br>    FROM tenant_balances tb<br>    LEFT JOIN cashbox_info ci ON ci."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    LEFT JOIN dedicated_treasury dt ON dt."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    LEFT JOIN tenant_names tn ON tn."TenantId" = tb."TenantId"<br>    ORDER BY <br>        CASE<br>            WHEN tb."TenantId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid THEN 0<br>            WHEN COALESCE(ci."CashboxCount", 0) = 0 THEN 1<br>            WHEN ci."CashboxCount" = 1 THEN 2<br>            ELSE 3<br>        END,<br>        ABS(tb."TotalBalance") DESC;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | `LEGACY DRIFT` | `public.analyze_legacy_cash_balances()` exists in the legacy database but is absent from the certified runtime-model baseline. Because the baseline is the canonical schema authority, this object is outside the current canonical implementation. |

| `public.migrate_legacy_cash_to_dedicated_accounts(p_dry_run boolean, p_operator_id uuid)` | `PosEcommerceDb` | Exists only in PosEcommerceDb. Definition: return=TABLE("TenantId" uuid, "MigrationCategory" text, "Status" text, "SourceBalance" numeric, "MigrationAmount" numeric, "TargetAccountCode" character varying, "JournalNumber" character varying, "Message" text); language=plpgsql; volatility=VOLATILE; definition=CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.migrate_legacy_cash_to_dedicated_accounts(p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT true, p_operator_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)<br> RETURNS TABLE("TenantId" uuid, "MigrationCategory" text, "Status" text, "SourceBalance" numeric, "MigrationAmount" numeric, "TargetAccountCode" character varying, "JournalNumber" character varying, "Message" text)<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_tenant_record RECORD;<br>    v_source_account_id uuid;<br>    v_source_balance decimal(18,4);<br>    v_target_account_id uuid;<br>    v_target_account_code varchar(20);<br>    v_cashbox_id uuid;<br>    v_cashbox_name varchar(200);<br>    v_journal_id uuid;<br>    v_journal_number varchar(50);<br>    v_migration_id uuid;<br>    v_idempotency_key varchar(255);<br>    v_migration_amount decimal(18,4);<br>    v_treasury_account_id uuid;<br>BEGIN<br>    -- Create temp table for analysis results<br>    CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _migration_analysis AS<br>    SELECT * FROM analyze_legacy_cash_balances();<br>    <br>    -- Process each tenant<br>    FOR v_tenant_record IN <br>        SELECT * FROM _migration_analysis <br>        WHERE "MigrationCategory" NOT IN ('D_INVALID_TENANT')<br>        ORDER BY "MigrationCategory", ABS("SharedCashBalance") DESC<br>    LOOP<br>        -- Initialize variables<br>        v_migration_amount := 0;<br>        v_target_account_id := null;<br>        v_target_account_code := null;<br>        v_journal_id := null;<br>        v_journal_number := null;<br>        <br>        -- Get the source treasury account and ledger account<br>        SELECT t."Id", a."Id", a."CurrentBalance"<br>        INTO v_treasury_account_id, v_source_account_id, v_source_balance<br>        FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>        INNER JOIN "LedgerAccounts" a ON a."Id" = t."AccountId"<br>        WHERE t."TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId"<br>          AND NOT t."IsDeleted"<br>          AND t."Type" = 1<br>          AND COALESCE(t."ReferenceCode", '') = ''<br>          AND a."AccountCode" = '1010'<br>        LIMIT 1;<br>        <br>        -- Handle based on category<br>        CASE v_tenant_record."MigrationCategory"<br>            -- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════<br>            -- CASE A: Auto-migrate (exactly 1 cashbox)<br>            -- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════<br>            WHEN 'A_AUTO_MIGRATE' THEN<br>                BEGIN<br>                    -- Get the single cashbox<br>                    v_cashbox_id := v_tenant_record."CashboxIds"[1];<br>                    v_cashbox_name := v_tenant_record."CashboxNames"[1];<br>                    <br>                    -- Find or create dedicated treasury account for this cashbox<br>                    -- First, check if it already exists<br>                    SELECT t."AccountId", a."AccountCode"<br>                    INTO v_target_account_id, v_target_account_code<br>                    FROM "TreasuryAccounts" t<br>                    INNER JOIN "LedgerAccounts" a ON a."Id" = t."AccountId"<br>                    WHERE t."TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId"<br>                      AND t."Type" = 1<br>                      AND t."ReferenceCode" = REPLACE(v_cashbox_id::text, '-', '')<br>                      AND NOT t."IsDeleted";<br>                    <br>                    -- If no dedicated account exists, we need to create one<br>                    IF v_target_account_id IS NULL THEN<br>                        -- Check if the ledger account exists (created by CashboxLedgerAccountService)<br>                        v_target_account_code := '1010-' \|\| UPPER(SUBSTRING(v_cashbox_id::text, 25, 8));<br>                        <br>                        SELECT "Id" INTO v_target_account_id<br>                        FROM "LedgerAccounts"<br>                        WHERE "TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId"<br>                          AND "AccountCode" = v_target_account_code<br>                          AND NOT "IsDeleted";<br>                        <br>                        -- If still no account, create it<br>                        IF v_target_account_id IS NULL THEN<br>                            IF NOT p_dry_run THEN<br>                                -- Create the dedicated ledger account<br>                                INSERT INTO "LedgerAccounts" (<br>                                    "Id", "TenantId", "AccountCode", "Name", "NameAr",<br>                                    "AccountType", "Level", "CurrentBalance",<br>                                    "IsSystem", "PreventNegative", "IsActive",<br>                                    "CreatedAtUtc", "ParentAccountId"<br>                                )<br>                                SELECT<br>                                    gen_random_uuid(),<br>                                    v_tenant_record."TenantId",<br>                                    v_target_account_code,<br>                                    'Cashbox - ' \|\| v_cashbox_name,<br>                                    'صندوق - ' \|\| COALESCE((<br>                                        SELECT "NameAr" FROM "Cashboxes" WHERE "Id" = v_cashbox_id<br>                                    ), v_cashbox_name),<br>                                    1, -- Asset<br>                                    2,<br>                                    0,<br>                                    false,<br>                                    true,<br>                                    true,<br>                                    now(),<br>                                    (SELECT "Id" FROM "LedgerAccounts" <br>                                     WHERE "TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId" <br>                                       AND "AccountCode" = '1010' <br>                                       AND NOT "IsDeleted" <br>                                     LIMIT 1)<br>                                RETURNING "Id" INTO v_target_account_id;<br>                            END IF;<br>                        END IF;<br>                        <br>                        -- Create the treasury account mapping<br>                        IF NOT p_dry_run AND v_target_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>                            INSERT INTO "TreasuryAccounts" (<br>                                "Id", "TenantId", "AccountId", "Type", "Name",<br>                                "ReferenceCode", "IsDefault", "IsActive", "DisplayOrder"<br>                            )<br>                            VALUES (<br>                                gen_random_uuid(),<br>                                v_tenant_record."TenantId",<br>                                v_target_account_id,<br>                                1, -- Cashbox<br>                                v_cashbox_name,<br>                                REPLACE(v_cashbox_id::text, '-', ''),<br>                                false,<br>                                true,<br>                                10<br>                            );<br>                        END IF;<br>                    END IF;<br>                    <br>                    -- Now perform the migration<br>                    IF v_target_account_id IS NOT NULL AND v_source_balance &lt;&gt; 0 THEN<br>                        v_migration_amount := v_source_balance;<br>                        <br>                        IF NOT p_dry_run THEN<br>                            -- Generate idempotency key<br>                            v_idempotency_key := 'LEGACY_CASH_MIGRATION:' \|\| v_tenant_record."TenantId"::text \|\| ':' \|\| v_cashbox_id::text;<br>                            <br>                            -- Check if already migrated<br>                            IF NOT EXISTS (<br>                                SELECT 1 FROM "JournalEntries" <br>                                WHERE "TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId"<br>                                  AND "IdempotencyKey" = v_idempotency_key<br>                            ) THEN<br>                                -- Create the journal entry<br>                                BEGIN<br>                                    -- Generate journal number<br>                                    v_journal_number := 'JE-' \|\| to_char(now(), 'YYYY') \|\| '-' \|\| <br>                                        LPAD(COALESCE(<br>                                            (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 <br>                                             FROM "JournalEntries" <br>                                             WHERE "TenantId" = v_tenant_record."TenantId"<br>                                               AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "PostedAtUtc") = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())),<br>                                            1<br>                                        )::text, 6, '0');<br>                                    <br>                                    -- Insert journal entry<br>                                    INSERT INTO "JournalEntries" (<br>                                        "Id", "TenantId", "JournalNumber", "JournalDate", "PostedAtUtc",<br>                                        "SourceType", "SourceId", "Description", "IdempotencyKey",<br>                                        "Status", "CreatedByUserId"<br>                                    )<br>                                    VALUES (<br>                                        gen_random_uuid(),<br>                                        v_tenant_record."TenantId",<br>                                        v_journal_number,<br>                                        CURRENT_DATE,<br>                                        now(),<br>                                        'LegacyCashMigration',<br>                                        v_cashbox_id,<br>                                        'Migration of legacy shared cash balance to dedicated cashbox account',<br>                                        v_idempotency_key,<br>                                        'Posted',<br>                                        p_operator_id<br>                                    )<br>                                    RETURNING "Id" INTO v_journal_id;<br>                                    <br>                                    -- Create ledger entries<br>                                    -- Debit: Target (dedicated cashbox account)<br>                                    INSERT INTO "LedgerEntries" (<br>                                        "Id", "AccountId", "JournalEntryId", "TenantId",<br>                                        "DebitAmount", "CreditAmount", "BalanceAfter",<br>                                        "CreatedAtUtc"<br>                                    )<br>                                    VALUES (<br>                                        gen_random_uuid(),<br>                                        v_target_account_id,<br> The legacy database contains schema shape that is not equivalent to the certified runtime-model baseline. Treat the legacy database as non-canonical for schema authority decisions until each listed difference is reviewed.

## 18. Engineering Recommendation

Do not treat `PosEcommerceDb` and `PosEcommerceDb_Baseline` as structurally interchangeable. Use the certified runtime-model baseline as the schema authority and review the difference inventory before any future migration, cutover, or data-copy decision.
